The frame limiter uses RivaTuner Statistics Server (RTSS), and it was not found on this PC.

Install RTSS (it comes with MSI Afterburner, or from guru3d.com), start it, then press Apply again.

RTSS must be running while you play: it does the actual limiting.
RtssInstallHelp.translation:
限帧功能需要 RivaTuner Statistics Server（RTSS），本机未找到 RTSS。

安装并启动 RTSS（可随 MSI Afterburner 一起安装，或从 guru3d.com 下载），再点击“应用”。

游戏期间请保持 RTSS 运行，否则限帧不会生效。

Copied {0} required file(s) to:
{1}

1. Install ReShade (with Add-on support) on the game first; this button copies only the required files.
2. Works on Direct3D 11 / 12 (GPU) and Direct3D 9 / 10 / OpenGL / Vulkan (CPU).

已将 {0} 个必需文件复制到：
{1}
